Fixed in PR #115 (squash 2367ff5). Cause: the inbox stream and bus_wait authenticated the bearer once and then worked only from the stored Principal ids (agent, space); revoke/leave/space delete/bus_revoke_admin/admin-token rotation delete the credential but keep those ids, and re-invite/re-mint reuses the agent row, so the old connection kept the stream slot (409 for the new token) and passed the Read filter for the new membership's mail. Fix: re-check the token (auth.Service.StillValid) after reading and before sending, once per wake-up and per page, and on every heartbeat (stream ends cleanly, slot released; bus_wait fails 401 invalid token). Smoke: revoke/leave/delete+recreate + re-invite, rotation, revoke_admin+re-mint, bus_wait all end without the new mail; idle ends within one heartbeat.

Fixed in PR #115 (squash 2367ff5). Cause: SSE frames were written and flushed with no write deadline (server sets no WriteTimeout by design for bus_wait), so a client that stops reading blocks the stream goroutine in conn.Write forever; ctx cancel cannot interrupt it, so the slot stays held (409 on reconnect), receipts stay live and shutdown hits its 10 s deadline. Fix: per-frame 30 s write deadline; on ctx end (shutdown/revocation) the deadline is cut to 250 ms; Info log 'inbox stream dropped: client not reading'. Smoke: stalled client dropped, reconnect 200 with backlog replay, shutdown with a stalled stream exits in 0.29 s.
